sources.entry: Wireshark - Wireshark is the world’s foremost and widely-used network protocol analyzer. It lets you see what’s happening on your network at a microscopic level and is the de facto (and often de jure) standard across many commercial and non-profit enterprises, government agencies, and educational institutions.

summary.name: Wireshark
summary.one_liner: Wireshark is a network protocol analyzer whose official source code repository is hosted on GitLab.
keywords: see what's happening on my network
use_cases: Tracking Wireshark release branches and tags
Inspecting packet captures in enterprise or education settings
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab file browser for the official Wireshark repository, showing the master branch with a branch and tag selector. It lists many release branches (such as release-4.4, release-5.0) and version tags (such as v5.0.0rc1, v4.7.4). The listing description calls Wireshark the world's most widely used network protocol analyzer, used to see network activity at a detailed level. The page text itself contains no feature list or download instructions beyond the repository view.
notable: Official Wireshark Foundation code repository on GitLab
Master branch plus many release-* branches and version tags
Donation link for the Wireshark Foundation on the meta description
caveats: The page shows only the source repository view; it does not describe the packaged application's features or platforms in detail
Page text shows a folder-loading error message, so the file listing is incomplete
